description_expanded: ABOUT CARIBBEAN SURF: Discover Caribbean Surf, a welcoming one-story beach house in Panama City Beach just 1.5 blocks from the shore, where relaxed coastal living meets easy access to sun, sand, and surf. This spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath retreat is designed for comfort and convenience, making it an ideal getaway for families and groups looking to unwind near the beach. Inside, the home offers an inviting atmosphere with multiple indoor and outdoor living areas, comfortable furnishings, and plenty of room for up to 10 guests. The fully equipped kitchen makes dining in a breeze, featuring a refrigerator, stove, oven, microwave, dishwasher, coffee makers, blender, toaster, ice maker, and all the essentials for preparing meals and snacks with ease. A dining area and kitchen island create a natural gathering place for sharing breakfast before the beach or a casual dinner after a day in the sun. The bedrooms include a king guest bedroom and king master suites, along wit a bunk bedroom that are perfect for younger guests or extra sleeping space. Two full bathrooms, including a convenient shower/tub combo, help keep mornings running smoothly. Guests also enjoy thoughtful comforts like central heating and air conditioning, ceiling fans, washer and dryer, hot water, linens, towels, hair dryer, iron, clothing storage, and dedicated workspace. Smart TVs, free WiFi, and high-speed internet add modern convenience for both entertainment and remote work. Step outside to enjoy the private heatable pool, fenced backyard, patio areas, sun loungers, outdoor seating, grill, and beach essentials ready for your stay. The fenced yard adds a sense of privacy, while the pool view enhances the relaxed vacation vibe. Guests frequently mention the home's comfortable layout, easy beach access, and the added bonus of a private pool as standout features. This dog-friendly home welcomes pets, so your four-legged companions can join in the fun. Beach chairs are available for guest use, and plenty of parking with garage access add to the ease of arrival. With self check-in, enhanced cleaning practices, outdoor lighting, the home is set up with guest comfort and safety in mind. Located near Panama City Beach's best-loved attractions, Caribbean Surf puts you close to waterfront dining, shopping, family-friendly activities, and endless Gulf Coast recreation. Guests rave about the convenient location, spacious layout, and the private pool that makes every stay feel special. Book your Panama City Beach escape at Caribbean Surf and enjoy the perfect blend of beach proximity, comfort, and laid-back luxury. ABOUT THE AREA The West End of Panama City Beach, Florida, is known for its serene and laid-back atmosphere, offering a more secluded and tranquil experience compared to the bustling areas in the heart of Panama City Beach. This area is characterized by its pristine white sandy beaches, crystal-clear emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, and picturesque natural beauty. Visitors to the West End can enjoy a more peaceful beach experience with fewer crowds, perfect for relaxation and unwinding. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the West End's proximity to natural attractions such as Camp Helen State Park and Conservation Park, where they can explore hiking and biking trails, spot local wildlife, and enjoy the beauty of the unique coastal landscape. Water sports enthusiasts can partake in activities such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling in the calm waters of the Gulf. For those seeking dining and entertainment options, the West End of Panama City Beach offers a selection of waterfront restaurants, beach bars, and cafes serving up fresh seafood and local cuisine. Visitors can also explore nearby shopping areas, art galleries, and cultural attractions in the surrounding area. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS * 2 King Beds, 2 Fulls, 2 Twins. * Beachside Location 1.5 blocks to beach access #86 * Private Pool * Dog Friendly * Fully Equipped Kitchen * Smart TVs & High-Speed WiFi * 4 Complimentary Backpack beach chairs and wagon Included * 4 Designated Parking Spots * Private Home * Optional pool heat available for $90 a day PARKING * 2 car garage + 3 designated driveway parking spaces PROPERTY RULES * Maximum occupancy: 10 guests * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hours of booking or reservation is subject to cancellation * Minimum age to book: 25 * Smoking is strictly prohibited in the property * All reservations are non-refundable - we strongly recommend purchasing travel insurance * Dog-friendly- Maximum of 2 dogs allowed. Weight limit is 75 lbs. A $250 pet fee applies. All pets must be approved in advance. * Property manager not responsible for construction or noise outside the home DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first-class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our homes are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained to the highest standard. Our local team is available 24/7 to ensure your stay is seamless and stress-free. Our mission: to help you create lasting memories, one beach vacation at a time.
